label: NECESSARY_12: actualist K necessity of the same actual root
definition: NecessaryRootActualistK sigma m w CN means there is one candidate n with ExistsAt w n and BoxExistsAt m.ontic w n, together with RootFacts sigma m w n. BoxExistsAt is de re existence at every accessible world. RootFacts separately requires an actual concrete ungrounded root, God, uniqueness as God and classical attributes. Actuality guards the same witness; it is not inferred from candidate-domain membership or from the box. CN is unused in this branch. This is the root-constrained actualist K reading, not a property of a frame and not a universal quantifier policy.
note: Analyst formulation, attribution deferred. Reuses the existing distinct meaning-bearing NecessaryRootActualistK declaration and its NecessaryIn .actualistK case; no opaque primitive is introduced. The root theorem connects this reading with the box-K root node because their common RootFacts already carries actuality. Outside RootFacts, an empty existence extension on a no-edge frame separates box-existence from actuality. Applicability of the supplied Ontic existence extension to act in esse remains open.
